component.name: Streamy
component.summary: Stream and record your screen, windows and camera

description.p: Streamy puts displays, windows, cameras, images and sound together in scenes and sends them live or to a file.

ul.li: Rounded corners, a stroke and a soft shadow on any widget, drawn on the graphics card
Drag, resize and snap widgets on the canvas; nudge them with the arrow keys
Stream to Twitch, YouTube or any RTMP server, with hardware encoding where the computer has it
Only the scene on screen captures; nothing runs while you aren't using it
